page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.24xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated resource allocation of the AMD EPYC processors provides predictable compute performance without resource contention. The balanced hardware profile is suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose workloads that require high core counts and substantial memory capacity without the need for specialized GPU acceleration or local NVMe storage.
